title: Treasury butterfly mean reversion (ZF vs ZT/ZN, vol-neutral legs)
rule: unit-vol leg returns u_x = r_x / vol_x (60d, lagged); fly s = u_ZF - 0.5 u_ZT - 0.5 u_ZN; index I = cumsum(s); z = (I - mean_L(I)) / sd_L(I); position p = -clip(z / 2, -1, 1) when |z| > th else 0, decided at the close and held from the next day (1-day lag); weights ZF p x 0.05/vol, ZT/ZN -p x 0.025/vol; daily_book costs
judgement: EQR book + entrant; ONE evaluation 2023-26 vs 1.143
